messages.text: BL-2071 🎵 in progress — A local seat forwards only a ticket whose acceptance feature passes: the iq3 coder's assert step is told to run the ticket's feature but nothing checks it, so QA finds the errors; a local-model seat's git_handoff is queued only when the ticket's acceptance feature passes at the forwarded commit, and the phase CLI's pass runs the same check
